title.zh: Crypto.com面向美国用户推出预测市场产品Predict Pro
title.en: Crypto.com面向美国用户推出预测市场产品Predict Pro

current_state.zh: Crypto.com rolled out Predict Pro for US users, a CFTC-regulated prediction market offering real-time order books, probability charts, risk-management tools, and multi-event combinatorial positions via NFA-registered introducing broker Foris DAX and OG.com Markets contracts.
